write_up: This is a strong outpatient PT resume! Your work at North Loop Sports Rehab connects your sports and post-surgical focus to a daily patient load, a return-to-run program and mentoring. Your earlier hospital clinic work adds orthopedic and neurological experience.

The return-to-run line is a great model: you named what you built and how many patients completed it. Your license and current role are easy to find. The patient-reported function result is promising, though a recruiter may wonder which patients and measure it covers.
Let's make that result more precise if you have the details. Your resume already gives a recruiter plenty to work with; competition and a clinic's particular patient needs will also matter.
